fileTitle: Sabio x PayPal: Win the Holiday Checkout
footer: Proactive point of view for Zenith

slides.title: Win the holiday checkout, one household at a time
slides.subtitle: Venmo is growing fast and branded checkout is flat. App Science® finds the homes that pay with another wallet, split costs with friends or shop early, and reaches them on TV before the holiday.
slides.meta: Proactive recommendation | Prepared for Zenith | October 2026 | US only
slides.names:
Will Phung · Amanda Grond · Stamos Biliris
Ben Bring · Isabella Imbriano

stat.label: Online branded checkout, Q2
stat.body: Total payment volume grew 9% to $486B, but online branded checkout grew 2%. Venmo volume grew 14%. Holiday is where checkout habits get set. [1]

slides.title: What's happening at PayPal right now
slides.kicker: Four signals from the last three months · Numbered sources on page 10

items.head: Branded checkout grew 2% for a second quarter
items.body: TPV rose 9% to $486B. PayPal plans to reinvest a large part of its savings in growth, including marketing. [1]
items.means: Checkout share is the number to move, and there is budget behind it.

items.head: Venmo volume up 14%, Pay with Venmo up 44%
items.body: Venmo posted its seventh straight quarter of double-digit growth. Buy now, pay later volume grew 26%. [1]
items.means: The growth products are the ones to put on TV this season.

items.head: Shoppers are worried but still spending
items.body: PayPal's survey found 58% feel more financial concern, 64% expect to spend the same or more, and 67% prefer retailers with rewards. [2]
items.means: Rewards and pay later are the reasons to choose PayPal at checkout.

items.head: Venmo Credit Card pays up to 4% when you split
items.body: Cardholders earn up to 4% cash back on purchases they split with friends through Venmo. [3]
items.means: Group holiday plans are a ready-made audience for the card.

slides.title: The opening: win the wallet before the cart
slides.kicker: Why holiday media should chase checkout share, not awareness
slides.statLabel: Of Americans are more likely to shop with a retailer that offers rewards or cash back.
slides.headline: We think PayPal grows checkout share this holiday by reaching the homes that already pay with something else.

points.head: The swing wallets are visible
points.body: Cash App, Klarna, Afterpay and Affirm all live on the phone. We can see which homes use them and which don't use PayPal.

points.head: Venmo is the growth story
points.body: Pay with Venmo grew 44%. Group plans and gift splitting peak in December, so the card has a natural moment.

points.head: The decision starts on the TV
points.body: Shoppers plan gifts early and pay later. We put the reason to choose PayPal on the TV, then follow the same home to the phone.

slides.title: Sabio at a glance
slides.kicker: Our own data, ad tech and content since 2014 · A Publicis partner for 9+ years
slides.takeaway: the homes paying with other wallets, splitting with friends or shopping early, found by the apps they use and reached on 115MM CTV households.

slides.title: Three audiences for the holiday checkout
slides.kicker: Each one is an app ecosystem, not a demographic · Sized on the final build
slides.source: We see which apps are on a device and when they were used, never balances, transactions or anything typed inside an app. PayPal and Venmo users can be suppressed for reach or reinforced. App lists finalized with PayPal and Zenith.

cards.name: The other wallet
cards.desc: Pays with Cash App or a pay-later app, and no PayPal app in the home.
cards.apps: Cash App · Klarna · Afterpay · Affirm · Zelle
cards.goal: Make PayPal and Pay Later the holiday default

cards.name: The group plan splitter
cards.desc: Uses Venmo and plans shared trips, dinners and tickets with friends.
cards.goal: Put the Venmo Credit Card's 4% split reward in front of them

cards.name: The early holiday shopper
cards.desc: Shops big-box retail apps weekly and compares deals before Thanksgiving.
cards.apps: Target · Walmart · Amazon Shopping · Best Buy · Honey
cards.goal: Choose PayPal at checkout for rewards and pay later

slides.side:
PayPal has said it will put savings back into marketing, and holiday is the biggest checkout moment of the year.

We think the fastest win is the homes already paying with something else.

That said, the Venmo card offer is brand new, so we'd want to confirm which product leads before we size anything.
